# Feature Specification: Matching data, candidates and case closure

**Feature Branch**: `pre-main--spec-desk-data`

**Created**: 2026-10-18 (Asia/Dhaka). Generated by Puku CLI Opus 4.8 worker for the pre-main convergence lane. Pre-main convergence desk output, not a human-approved spec.

**Status**: Draft for human skim; specification only. Derives intent from the V2 spec pack (`docs/spec/`), the actual architecture in `src/server/matching/`, `src/server/duplicates/`, `src/server/dashboard/`, `src/server/case/` and the existing `docs/execution/evidence/` documents.

**Input**: V2 pack D1 FR-011–FR-018, D2A API-007–API-013, D3 SCREEN-007, SCREEN-009, SCREEN-010, SCREEN-011, SCREEN-012, D6 TASK-015, TASK-017, TASK-018, TASK-026–TASK-030, TASK-064, BR-001, BR-005, BR-012, BR-013, BR-017, BR-018, BR-019, BR-020, BR-021.

**Owner**: Masnun (matching / embeddings / duplicates / dashboard / data). The convergence-desk lane only writes this spec; it does not write the matching code.

This feature covers the desk-side data path: 64 districts, the synthetic 200-record manifest with identity grouping and frozen hashes, the embedding service and reembed script, the matcher (filters, cosine, bonuses, template reasons), the duplicate detector, the staff found-child log, the officer queue, the match-review page, the case detail/close, the dashboard map and counts, and the evaluation harness that consumes the manifest on the dev split first and on the held-out split after freeze. The desk UI is bilingual; officer views show candidates and other-party evidence only when the actor is an active verified officer; the map and counts are admin-visible. (STORY-008–STORY-014, STORY-021, STORY-022; SCREEN-007, SCREEN-009, SCREEN-010, SCREEN-011, SCREEN-012, SCREEN-014, SCREEN-015; FR-011–FR-019, FR-022, FR-023, FR-028, FR-036; BR-001, BR-005, BR-012, BR-013, BR-014, BR-017, BR-018, BR-019, BR-020, BR-021, BR-026; TASK-009, TASK-010, TASK-011, TASK-015, TASK-016, TASK-017, TASK-018, TASK-019, TASK-026, TASK-027, TASK-028, TASK-029, TASK-030, TASK-039, TASK-051, TASK-064; TC-008, TC-009, TC-010, TC-011, TC-012, TC-013, TC-020, TC-064, TC-035)

## User Scenarios & Testing *(mandatory)*

Stories 1–6 support V2 Must behaviour; Story 7 is the duplicate-review Should; Story 8 is the disaster-mode Could. P1/P2 reflect source priorities from D1/D6; this list does not introduce a new ranking.

### User Story 1 - Log a synthetic found child and queue matching (Priority: P1)

A staff member signs in (TASK-006, FR-037), opens SCREEN-007, completes the found-child form (or supplies free text on TASK-020 integration), reviews, and saves. The system creates a found case with `is_synthetic = true`, marks it `open`, schedules matching and returns a stable reference. The staff member's own report is the only payload they see; no candidate or other-party evidence is projected. (STORY-008; FR-011, FR-020; BR-004, BR-006, BR-013; SCREEN-007, SCREEN-016; API-007; TASK-026)

**Why this priority**: Must requirement (GOAL-003, A-021). The matcher cannot rank against a missing report unless a found report exists with stable provenance and the staff-side review-before-save path is in place.

**Independent Test**: With a signed-in staff session, save one found-child report, assert the response is 201 with the caller's own report only, assert no candidate detail in the staff projection, assert `matching_state` returns `queued|running|complete|failed` and never a candidate list. (TC-008, TC-022; OD-026-1, OD-026-4)

**Acceptance Scenarios**:

1. **Given** a signed-in staff member, **when** they save a found-child form with reviewed fields, **then** a synthetic found case is created in `open` state, the staff's own projection shows their report, and no candidate details are returned. (FR-011, FR-020; BR-006, BR-007, BR-013; TC-008, TC-022)
2. **Given** an identical staff retry with the same scoped UUID, **when** the request replays, **then** the same found case is returned (200) with `submission_replayed: true`. (FR-031; TC-031, TC-042)
3. **Given** a staff retry with a changed payload, **when** the request replays, **then** the response is E-006 (conflict) and a second report is not created. (FR-031; TC-031, TC-042)
4. **Given** a signed-in staff member with the per-principal 30/min limit, **when** they exceed it, **then** the route returns E-007 (rate limit) and never auto-creates a report. (OD-026-3)
5. **Given** a "save" action with blank required fields, **when** the form is submitted, **then** the save is refused (E-001 / inline error) and the form is not submitted. (FR-011, BR-015, BR-016; TC-001, TC-008)

---

### User Story 2 - Run the matcher on the manifest and produce a frozen evaluation (Priority: P1)

With one command, the team computes the five promised metrics (Recall@5, top-1 precision with coverage, query-level P@5 + named aggregate shortlist precision, no-match false suggestions + abstention, duplicate precision/recall/F1) on the dev split first, and on the held-out split only after the manifest, model, preprocessing, threshold and prompt/template hashes are frozen. Demo mode and caches are disabled. The report has denominators, abstention/coverage, baselines (manual timing, rules-only, embeddings-only where feasible) and at least two failure examples. (STORY-022; FR-028; TASK-039, TASK-043, TASK-064; GOAL-001–GOAL-005, GOAL-008, GOAL-009; TC-020, TC-056, TC-064; D2 Part B §17)

**Why this priority**: Must requirement (GOAL-009, Constitution VI/VII). Honest reporting needs held-out measurement with no cache or fixture contamination.

**Independent Test**: Run the harness on the dev split, then once on the held-out split after the manifest, model and threshold freeze, with demo mode and caches disabled. Inspect the report sections, the hashes and the failure examples. (TC-020, TC-056, TC-064)

**Acceptance Scenarios**:

1. **Given** the frozen grouped manifest (80 missing + 80 found + 40 decoys = 200 records; 60 true pairs; 20 no-match queries; 25 duplicate links; identity-grouped 40/60 dev/test split with actual counts reported), **when** the held-out run executes, **then** the report gives the five metrics with numerator/denominator, coverage, abstention, baseline and ≥2 failure examples. (TASK-039, TASK-043, TASK-064; GOAL-003, GOAL-004; TC-020, TC-064; D2 Part B §17)
2. **Given** a quality run, **when** any cache or fixture response is hit, **then** the affected result is rejected or excluded and labelled; fixture output is never reported as a metric. (TC-056; FR-027; D2 Part B §17)
3. **Given** the final run on the freeze build, **when** the report is committed, **then** it records the commit, model revision, manifest and prompt/template hashes, date, hardware or deploy, and model/account mode, and includes ≥2 failure examples. (TASK-043; TC-020; STORY-022 AC1)
4. **Given** a held-out run that suggests a threshold, prompt or model change, **when** the change is proposed, **then** it is refused in this lane; the heldout set is **not** tuned on. A new manifest or new heldout set is required. (PHASE_3 AMD-3-3; AMD-AGENTS-5; OD-064-1)

---

### User Story 3 - Rank up to five qualified candidates nationally with evidence (Priority: P1)

A missing report enters the matcher. The matcher applies the BR-017 hard filters (sex-age compatibility, age range overlap, missing report not yet confirmed, both endpoints in a queue status, neither redacted), then computes a similarity score with cosine + bonuses, and emits up to five candidates with the score, the components, the reasons in bn/en and a re-rank-free ordering. District is a soft bonus, never a gate. An empty shortlist is a valid result. (STORY-009; FR-012, FR-013, FR-014; BR-017, BR-018; SCREEN-009, SCREEN-016; API-008; TASK-017, TASK-027)

**Why this priority**: Must requirement (GOAL-003, A-024, A-025). The candidate shortlist is the only thing the officer sees; an empty shortlist is honest when nothing is close.

**Independent Test**: Seed a known manifest, run the matcher, inspect the JSON for ≤5 candidates, BR-017 filter reasons, score components, district bonus and an empty shortlist when the missing report is not yet close to any found. (TC-009; OD-017-1)

**Acceptance Scenarios**:

1. **Given** a missing report with reviewed fields, **when** the matcher runs, **then** the queue lists pending candidates with the missing report newest-candidate-first, ≤5 candidates, score and evidence reasons per candidate. (FR-012, FR-014; BR-017; TC-009)
2. **Given** a candidate that fails a hard filter (sex incompatible, no age overlap, missing report already confirmed, one endpoint redacted, one endpoint not in queue status), **when** the matcher runs, **then** the candidate is not emitted and a filter reason is recorded. (FR-013; BR-017; TC-009)
3. **Given** a candidate with a close match, **when** the matcher runs, **then** the score is `cosine + bonuses`, the components include `cosine`, `district_bonus`, `age_overlap_bonus` and `time_anchor_bonus`, and the score is labelled "similarity" not "probability". (FR-012; BR-018; TC-009)
4. **Given** a missing report with no close match, **when** the matcher runs, **then** the shortlist is empty and the queue reads "no close match" (bn + en). (FR-012; BR-017, BR-018; TC-009)
5. **Given** a candidate queued for a missing report that is later edited, **when** the matcher re-runs, **then** the prior candidates are voided with `match.voided` and a new candidate set is created. (BR-012, BR-019; TC-053)

---

### User Story 4 - Show evidence side-by-side and let the officer record a decision (Priority: P1)

A verified officer opens the candidate from the queue, sees missing and found records side by side with agree / differ / unknown per field (sex, age, district), with a "compare by eye" verdict for free text, height, time and a different district. Confirm and Reject are two-step dialogs; Reject needs a 3–500 character reason. Confirm runs the case-service one-transaction protocol: lock both endpoints in sorted UUID order, recheck versions and authorisation, write the decision, void competitors, record the simulated referral, reconcile both states, write the audit. (STORY-010, STORY-011, STORY-012, STORY-017; FR-015, FR-016, FR-017, FR-018, FR-021; BR-001, BR-005, BR-012, BR-013, BR-020, BR-024; SCREEN-010, SCREEN-012, SCREEN-016; API-009, API-010, API-011; TASK-028, TASK-029)

**Why this priority**: Must requirement (GOAL-006, GOAL-008). The officer is the only authority for confirmation; partial or stale decisions would make both case histories misleading.

**Independent Test**: Confirm once on a known candidate, race a competing decision, attempt an illegal state jump, inspect referral, states, audit, and rejected retries; check TC-010, TC-011, TC-016, TC-029, TC-032, TC-046, TC-047, TC-051, TC-053. (D2B §10.1)

**Acceptance Scenarios**:

1. **Given** a pending candidate and an active verified officer, **when** they confirm, **then** one transaction writes the decision, the confirmed candidate, the voided competitors, `match.confirm`, the referral record (simulation) and `referral.recorded`; the missing case moves to `confirmed` and the found case moves to `referred`. (FR-016, FR-018, FR-021; BR-001, BR-005, BR-012, BR-013, BR-020; TC-010, TC-016)
2. **Given** the same candidate and a second officer's request, **when** the second confirm attempts, **then** it is refused (E-005) and no second decision is written. (BR-012, BR-020; TC-029, TC-032)
3. **Given** a candidate whose expected version is stale, **when** the officer confirms, **then** the request is refused (E-005) and a new pending candidate is offered (reconcile). (BR-012, BR-019; TC-029, TC-053)
4. **Given** a Reject with a 3–500 character reason, **when** the officer saves, **then** the candidate is removed from the queue with `match.reject`, the reason is stored in bn/en and the audit row carries the reason only, not the candidate payload. (FR-017; BR-013, BR-020; TC-011)
5. **Given** a candidate page read where the candidate does not exist or the officer is not active-verified, **when** the request is made, **then** the same `not-found` envelope is returned and `access.denied` is appended with a null FK when the case is unknown. (BR-007, BR-010, BR-024; SCREEN-016; TC-022, TC-052)

---

### User Story 5 - Close a missing case with a V2 coordination outcome (Priority: P1)

After a confirmed pair, an active verified officer closes the missing case with `coordination_recorded` (requires the confirmed pair's referral record) or, from an open missing case, with `resolved_outside_fera`. The close writes `case.closed` with the outcome and a `reason_recorded: true` flag, sets `closed_at` and audits. A found report and stale `expected_version` are refused (E-005). (STORY-012, STORY-013, STORY-016; FR-018, FR-019, FR-025; BR-009, BR-012, BR-013, BR-025; SCREEN-012; API-011, API-013; TASK-029)

**Why this priority**: Must requirement (GOAL-006, Safeguarding). Close is the only place that creates the closure record; the V2 outcome and redaction are coupled to it.

**Independent Test**: Close a confirmed missing case with `coordination_recorded`, attempt a re-close, attempt `coordination_recorded` from an open case, attempt `resolved_outside_fera` on a confirmed case, attempt close as a non-officer; check TC-010, TC-012, TC-015, TC-029. (D2B §10.1)

**Acceptance Scenarios**:

1. **Given** a confirmed missing case with the referral record, **when** the officer closes with `coordination_recorded`, **then** the case is `closed`, the audit row `case.closed` carries the outcome and `reason_recorded: true`, the note is stored but never audited, and the eligible-count for redaction increases by 1. (FR-018, FR-025; BR-009, BR-012, BR-013; TC-010, TC-012, TC-015)
2. **Given** an open missing case, **when** the officer closes with `resolved_outside_fera`, **then** the case is `closed` and the audit row carries the outcome; no referral record is required. (FR-018; BR-012, BR-013; TC-029)
3. **Given** a confirmed case, **when** the officer attempts `resolved_outside_fera`, **then** the request is refused (E-005) and the case stays `confirmed`. (BR-012, BR-013; TC-029)
4. **Given** a re-close attempt, **when** the officer closes again, **then** the request is refused (E-005) and no new audit row is written. (BR-012, BR-013; TC-029, TC-032)
5. **Given** a non-officer or unverified-officer attempting close, **when** the request is made, **then** the request is refused (E-004) and `access.denied` is written. (BR-007, BR-024; TC-022, TC-052)

---

### User Story 6 - Show district counts and a synthetic map (Priority: P1)

SCREEN-011 shows separate counts for missing-report rows, found-report rows and confirmed pairs by district, with an accessible icon + text + colour for each. The map uses bundled district outlines; no exact coordinates; every seeded record carries the visible "সিনথেটিক" label. (STORY-013; FR-019, FR-032; BR-014, BR-026; SCREEN-011; API-012; TASK-030)

**Why this priority**: Must requirement (GOAL-006, A-022). Honest counts distinguish three kinds of rows; the map and the table share the same numbers.

**Independent Test**: Seed the manifest, open SCREEN-011, assert the per-district missing / found / confirmed counts match the seeded aggregate, assert the synthetic label is visible, assert exact coordinates are never present. (TC-012, TC-021)

**Acceptance Scenarios**:

1. **Given** a seeded manifest, **when** the dashboard loads, **then** per-district counts are present for missing, found and confirmed; the icons, text and colour are accessible (WCAG 2.2 AA). (FR-019; BR-014; TC-012)
2. **Given** the map view, **when** it loads, **then** only bundled district outlines and a `সিনথেটিক` chip are shown; no photo, no face, no exact coordinate. (FR-019, FR-032; BR-006, BR-026; TC-012, TC-021)
3. **Given** the table view, **when** it loads, **then** a staff member sees their own found cases, a verified officer sees candidate counts and confirmed pairs, and an admin sees aggregate counts without candidate IDs. (BR-007, BR-014, BR-024; TC-019, TC-022, TC-044, TC-045)

---

### User Story 7 - Flag possible duplicates while keeping every unreviewed report independently discoverable (Priority: P1)

The duplicate detector scans for same-name + same-dob or near-embedding duplicates and emits a "possible duplicate" banner on the match review page. Shared phone alone never suppresses a report. A duplicate link is shown in the queue and on the case detail; dismissal is reviewed reversible. (STORY-014; FR-022, FR-023; BR-007, BR-021; SCREEN-014; API-014; TASK-018, TASK-051)

**Why this priority**: Must requirement (GOAL-004). Honest detection without suppression preserves reviewability.

**Independent Test**: Seed two reports that share a phone number and a report that shares a name + dob, run the duplicate detector, assert the shared-phone pair is **not** suppressed and the name+dob pair is flagged. (TC-013, TC-022)

**Acceptance Scenarios**:

1. **Given** two reports that share only a phone number, **when** the duplicate detector runs, **then** no duplicate link is emitted and both reports remain independently discoverable. (FR-022; BR-007, BR-021; TC-013, TC-022)
2. **Given** two reports that share name + dob, **when** the detector runs, **then** a duplicate link is emitted with profile evidence and reason; the original reports stay discoverable until the officer dismisses the link. (FR-022, FR-023; BR-021; TC-013)
3. **Given** a duplicate link, **when** an officer dismisses it, **then** the dismissal is audited and the original reports are unchanged. (FR-023; BR-021; TC-013)

---

### User Story 8 - Disaster-mode logging screen (Priority: P3)

A disaster-mode logging screen (SCREEN-015) is a planned extension labelled "পরিকল্পিত" in the UI; the API is a stub that returns 501 with `E-019` and writes no record. (STORY-021; FR-036; OQ-003; SCREEN-015; TASK-052; TC-035)

**Why this priority**: Could in D6. The screen is labelled but not implemented in this lane unless the mentor table names it.

**Independent Test**: Open SCREEN-015, assert the planned label is visible, submit a form, assert 501 and no record written. (TC-035; OD-052-1)

**Acceptance Scenarios**:

1. **Given** SCREEN-015, **when** it loads, **then** the planned label is visible and no form is submittable to a live endpoint. (FR-036; OQ-003; TC-035)
2. **Given** a submit, **when** the request is made, **then** the API returns 501 and writes nothing. (FR-036; TC-035)

---

### Edge Cases

- The manifest, model, thresholds, prompt/templates or preprocessing change after a heldout run was committed: the new build needs a new freeze and, if the old set influenced the choice, a fresh independent heldout set. No heldout tuning. (PHASE_3 AMD-3-3)
- The matcher emits an empty shortlist: the queue shows "no close match" (bn + en); no candidate row is shown; the officer can edit the missing report (BR-012). (FR-012; BR-017, BR-018)
- A candidate page is requested after the candidate is voided: same `not-found` envelope, `access.denied` audit, null FK. (BR-007, BR-010; SCREEN-016)
- An officer confirms with a stale `expected_version` (because the missing report was edited, the candidate was voided, the found report was redacted, or the endpoint moved out of queue status): E-005, the queue re-runs, and the officer is offered a new pending candidate if one exists. (BR-012, BR-019; TC-029, TC-053)
- A duplicate link is dismissed while a new report with the same name + dob is created: the dismissal is preserved, the new report is independently discoverable, and the detector does not auto-re-link. (FR-023; BR-021)
- A staff retry is identical in payload but a new client UUID is supplied: a second report is created (the spec keeps the prior one). The fix is a server-side near-duplicate guard or tombstone (OD-026-4).
- A paid AI call is made during the matcher: that is a violation; the matcher must not call LLMs (BR-026; AMD-AGENTS-5). (D6 §5)
- A redaction run on a case whose pair is still active (missing confirmed, found referred but missing not closed): the redactor keeps the active linked evidence (BR-009; TC-015).

## Requirements *(mandatory)*

### Scope and boundaries

Feature 004 owns the matching-data work mapped to TASK-009, TASK-010, TASK-011, TASK-015 (case service and state guard — shared with feature 001), TASK-016, TASK-017, TASK-018, TASK-019, TASK-026, TASK-027, TASK-028, TASK-029, TASK-030, TASK-039, TASK-051, TASK-064. It consumes behaviour built in features 001 and 002 and changes none of their requirements. Fixes found here go to the matching-data owner under AGENTS ownership. Every record is invented and synthetic; no real child, photo, face, alert, physical return, police or CID integration, or legal-compliance claim is in scope. (BR-002, BR-006, BR-026)

### Functional Requirements

- **TASK-009, TASK-010, TASK-064; FR-019, FR-022, FR-032**: 64 districts (codes 1–64, bn/en names, division, 2-decimal centroids, neighbours) and an identity-grouped frozen manifest (200 records, 60 true pairs, 20 no-match, 25 duplicate links, dev/test split 40/60) load via `npm run seed -- --set demo|full` and via `db/seed/districts.mjs`. The manifest carries a hash, a `provenance` block and a `verified_by`/`source` for any adjacency check; the heldout split is consumed read-only. (BR-014, BR-026; TC-021)
- **TASK-016**: `npm run reembed` produces deterministic 384-d vectors for missing and found records; the embedding service is provider-free; pgvector HNSW index is on host and locally. (FR-012; BR-018; D2 Part A §5.4)
- **TASK-017; D6 §5**: The matcher applies BR-017 hard filters (sex-age compatibility, age range overlap, missing report not yet confirmed, both endpoints in queue status, neither redacted), then computes `cosine + bonuses` (district soft bonus, age-overlap bonus, time-anchor bonus) and emits ≤5 candidates with the score, components and bn/en reasons. (FR-012, FR-013, FR-014; BR-017, BR-018; TC-009)
- **TASK-018; FR-022, FR-023**: The duplicate detector emits links on same-name + same-dob and near-embedding, never on shared phone alone, and the dismissal is reviewed reversible. (BR-007, BR-021; TC-013)
- **TASK-026; FR-011**: SCREEN-007 + API-007 save a found report with `is_synthetic = true`, owner + source server-derived, idempotency by `submissionPayloadHash` + `classifySubmission`, matching queued. The staff projection shows the staff's own report only. (BR-004, BR-006, BR-007, BR-013, BR-024; TC-008, TC-022, TC-031, TC-042)
- **TASK-027; FR-014**: API-008 lists pending candidates for verified officers, newest-candidate first, ≤5 per missing report, missing and found projected through the officer projection. (BR-007, BR-024; TC-009, TC-022)
- **TASK-028; FR-015, FR-016, FR-017**: API-009 reads a candidate through the officer projection, returning `hidden` and writing `access.denied` on absent/forbidden. API-010 writes the decision with the case service one-transaction protocol (sorted UUID locks, version recheck, void competitors, both states, referral record, audit). Reject requires 3–500 character reason. (BR-001, BR-005, BR-007, BR-012, BR-013, BR-020, BR-024; TC-010, TC-011, TC-016, TC-022, TC-029, TC-032, TC-046, TC-052, TC-053)
- **TASK-029; FR-018, FR-021, FR-025**: API-011 closes a missing case with `coordination_recorded` (requires confirmed + referral) or `resolved_outside_fera` (requires open), refuses re-close and non-officer; API-013 lists audit. (BR-007, BR-009, BR-012, BR-013, BR-024, BR-025; TC-010, TC-012, TC-015, TC-016, TC-029, TC-032)
- **TASK-030; FR-019, FR-032**: SCREEN-011 + API-012 show per-district missing / found / confirmed counts with accessible icon + text + colour, a synthetic chip, and a map with bundled outlines and no exact coordinates. (BR-014, BR-026; TC-012, TC-021)
- **TASK-039, TASK-043; FR-028; TC-020, TC-056, TC-064**: The evaluation harness runs on the dev split first and on the heldout split only after the manifest, model, preprocessing, threshold and prompt/template hashes are frozen. Demo mode and caches are disabled. The report covers the five metrics with numerators/denominators, abstention/coverage, baselines, ≥2 failure examples and the hashes. (Constitution VI/VII; D2 Part B §17)
- **TASK-051; FR-023**: SCREEN-014 + API-014 let an officer mark a duplicate link as same/different with profile evidence and a reason; the original reports stay discoverable. (BR-007, BR-021; TC-013)
- **TASK-052; FR-036; OQ-003**: SCREEN-015 shows a "পরিকল্পিত" panel and the API returns 501 / E-019 with no record written. (TC-035)

### Key Entities

- **District (64 rows)**: `code (1–64)`, `name_en`, `name_bn`, `division_en`, 2-decimal lat/lng centroid, `neighbours (codes)`. (TASK-009; ENTITY-010, ENTITY-011; BR-014)
- **Synthetic record (manifest, 200 rows)**: `id (UUID)`, `kind (missing|found)`, fields per contracts, embedding, `is_synthetic = true`. (TASK-010, TASK-016, TASK-019; FR-022, FR-032)
- **Candidate**: `id`, `missing_case_id`, `found_case_id`, `score`, `components`, `reasons_bn`, `reasons_en`, `status (pending|confirmed|rejected|voided)`, `expected_version_missing`, `expected_version_found`. (TASK-017, TASK-028; FR-012, FR-013)
- **Decision**: `id`, `candidate_id`, `actor_id`, `kind (confirm|reject)`, `reason_bn?`, `reason_en?`, `decided_at`. (TASK-028; FR-016, FR-017)
- **Referral (simulation)**: `id`, `pair_id`, `missing_case_id`, `found_case_id`, `recorded_by`, `recorded_at`. (TASK-028; BR-005; FR-016, FR-018)
- **Duplicate link**: `id`, `left_case_id`, `right_case_id`, `kind (same_name_dob|near_embedding)`, `evidence`, `dismissed_at?`, `dismissed_by?`, `reason?`. (TASK-018, TASK-051; FR-022, FR-023)
- **Audit (append-only)**: `id`, `actor_id`, `actor_role`, `action`, `case_fk?`, `candidate_fk?`, `details` (typed, no free text), `at`. (TASK-015; FR-021; BR-010; TC-016)
- **Evaluation report**: dated, frozen, hashed, with the five metrics, denominators, abstention/coverage, baselines, ≥2 failure examples, commit, model, manifest, prompt/template, preprocessing and threshold hashes. (TASK-043; FR-028; TC-020, TC-064; D2 Part B §17)

## Success Criteria *(mandatory)*

### Measurable Outcomes

These are acceptance targets for the matching-data work. None is an achieved result at specification time.

- **SC-001**: `npm run seed -- --set demo|full` loads the 64-district dataset plus 200-record manifest (or `--set demo` loads 3 labelled demo cases) and is idempotent. (TASK-009, TASK-010, TASK-019)
- **SC-002**: The matcher emits ≤5 candidates per missing report on the dev split, with a Recall@5 ≥ 0.80 and top-1 precision ≥ 0.60 with coverage, abstention and baseline reported. (TASK-017, TASK-039; GOAL-003; TC-020, TC-064)
- **SC-003**: A heldout run, run once with caches and demo mode disabled, reports the five metrics with numerator/denominator, ≥2 failure examples, 0 cache hits counted, and recorded commit / model / manifest / prompt-template / preprocessing / threshold hashes. (TASK-039, TASK-043, TASK-064; FR-028; GOAL-009; TC-020, TC-056, TC-064)
- **SC-004**: Confirm and Reject on the same candidate with a competing request yields one decision row, one referral record (simulation), one `match.confirm` and `referral.recorded` audit, and one refused second request. (TASK-028; FR-016; BR-012, BR-020; TC-010, TC-016, TC-029)
- **SC-005**: The duplicate detector emits 0 links on shared-phone pairs and ≥1 link on a same-name + same-dob pair; shared phone never suppresses. (TASK-018, TASK-051; FR-022; BR-007, BR-021; TC-013)
- **SC-006**: SCREEN-011 shows per-district missing / found / confirmed counts that match the seeded aggregate; every count is icon + text + colour; the synthetic chip is visible. (TASK-030; FR-019, FR-032; BR-014, BR-026; TC-012)
- **SC-007**: Close with `coordination_recorded` works only from a confirmed case with a referral; `resolved_outside_fera` works only from an open case; re-close is refused. (TASK-029; FR-018; BR-012, BR-013; TC-010, TC-029)
- **SC-008**: A full journey's logs contain 0 phone numbers and 0 seeded child names. (TC-028; NFR-010)

## Assumptions, dependencies and open decisions

- **Upstream dependencies**: TASK-002 (DB), TASK-006 (auth), TASK-007 (API envelope), TASK-008 (layout), TASK-012 (normaliser) and TASK-061 (contracts) from features 001/002 gate this feature (D6 §5).
- **Matcher owner**: TASK-017 and the matcher, embeddings, duplicates, queue, match-review, dashboard map and counts are Masnun's owned code (`src/server/matching/`, `src/server/duplicates/`, `src/server/dashboard/`, `src/app/(desk)/officer/{queue,match,map,duplicates}`, `src/app/(desk)/staff/`). The convergence desk does not modify these.
- **Shared case service**: TASK-015 is shared with feature 001 (Mahim); this feature consumes it and the state guard, audit, decisions, close and read contracts. (BR-012, BR-020; D2 Part A §3.3–3.4)
- **Schedule (UNKNOWN)**: 14 Oct 2026 22:00 Asia/Dhaka is the working baseline; the new cutoff, channel, recipient and exact deck/video formats are UNKNOWN until the lead records organiser evidence. (AGENTS AMD-AGENTS-1; PHASE_4 AMD-4-1)
- **Heldout freeze**: A change to the manifest, model, thresholds, prompt/templates or preprocessing after a heldout run invalidates the frozen report for the new build. No heldout tuning. (PHASE_3 AMD-3-3; AMD-AGENTS-5)
- **Open decisions**:
  - OD-009-1: District codes are positional (alphabetical) and frozen; is that acceptable, or should a stable slug be added? (Masnun, then all owners)
  - OD-009-2: Who verifies centroids, names and adjacency against a public source, and by when? (UNKNOWN)
  - OD-009-3: `division_en` is stored as English only; a Bangla division name is not in the schema. (Masnun / Obidit)
  - OD-017-1: District is a soft bonus, never a gate; what is the right value? (Masnun)
  - OD-026-1: Add an own-found-report projection to `src/contracts` so officers need no re-projection workaround. (all three owners)
  - OD-026-3: Per-principal 30/min write limit on API-007 is not from the spec pack. (Mahim)
  - OD-026-4: After an "uncertain" save and an edit, a second report can be created. Server-side near-duplicate guard or tombstone? (all three owners)
  - OD-028-1: A fourth "compare by eye" verdict and a different district shown as "compare by eye". (Masnun, Mahim)
  - OD-028-3: Per-principal limits on API-009/010 (120/min, 30/min) are not from the spec pack. (Mahim)
  - OD-028-4: D3 SCREEN-010 success string and English dialog sentence overclaim; spec pack needs the wording fix. (all three owners)
  - OD-052-1: Disaster-mode API is a 501 stub; the form is "পরিকল্পিত". (Masnun, unless mentor table says otherwise)
  - OD-064-1: Heldout set is consumed read-only; no tuning. A new manifest, model, threshold or template change needs a new freeze and, if the old set influenced the choice, a fresh independent heldout set. (Masnun, all owners)
- **Matcher cannot call LLMs**: That is a violation; the matcher uses the embedding service and a deterministic score. (BR-026; AMD-AGENTS-5)

## Notes

- The convergence desk writes this spec; **no application code** is modified. The existing matcher, queue, match-review, case detail, dashboard, duplicate and found-log code is the spec-kit evidence. Owner-area changes are out of scope.
- "Buildable" means "can be implemented, tested and merged by a lane without waiting on organiser or human evidence." The buildable task board is in [plan.md](plan.md) and [tasks.md](tasks.md).
- This spec keeps the V2 spec pack and the constitution as the only sources of intent; the spec-kit artifacts record the convergence lane's view, not a rewrite of the pack.
